async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Fill in the issue title
    title_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Title (required)')
    await title_input.fill("Let's keep the project alive")
    
    # Step 2: Fill in the description with quick actions to assign to myself and set due date
    description_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Description')
    await description_input.fill('/assign @Byte Blaze\n/due 2033-03-31')
    
    # Step 3: Submit the issue
    submit_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Submit issue')
    if await submit_button.count() > 0:
        await submit_button.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    else:
        # Fallback if 'Submit issue' button not found
        submit_button_fallback = page.get_by_role('button', name='Create issue')
        if await submit_button_fallback.count() > 0:
            await submit_button_fallback.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
